text:
Leah M.: Candidate (Nadia S) wrote in: shes traveling with a 6mo and asks if we can split the onsite into two short windows (AM behavioral + PM system design) so she can do daycare pickup. Also asked about a private prayer/meditation room between sessions.
Rohan (Recruiter): Splitting is doable if panels can flex. Which windows does she want?
Leah M.: She prefers 9:00-10:15 AM for behavioral + 4:30-6:00 PM for system design. Will need at least 45 mins between for pickup/feeding.
Sam (People Ops): We can propose that option. I'll check panel availability and approve a one-off childcare reimbursement up to $125 for pickup overlap. Please confirm she needs reimbursement before booking.
Rohan (Recruiter): She asked for reimbursement and will submit a receipt. Also wants a lactation-friendly private room during the PM slot in case she needs to pump.
Leah M.: Noted. Facilities: can we reserve a private room that can serve as prayer/lactation space and has a small fridge?
Facilities Bot: Reserve "Room H" (single-occupancy) 10:30-11:15 AM and 4:00-6:30 PM. Mini-fridge and lock sign-out added. Room lighting set to warm; door sign "Private - please do not enter" will be available.
Sam (People Ops): Approving childcare reimbursement up to $125. Instruction to candidate: email receipt to expenses@redwood.com with subject "Candidate Care - Nadia S" and we process within 5 business days.
Rohan (Recruiter): For the PM panel one lead requested remote option. Can system design be hybrid? Candidate prefers in-person for the coding portion but ok remote for one interviewer.
Leah M.: Hybrid is fine — we'll explicitly mark which interviewer is remote. Also candidate asked for a vegan + gluten-free lunch; can cafe handle that?
Facilities Bot: Catering ordered: Vegan GF box + oat milk beverage. Labelled Nadia S.
Sam (People Ops): Candidate also asked about parking validation for parent who may drop off and pick up. We can validate 3 hours; front desk voucher will be issued.
Rohan (Recruiter): She prefers to use her Mac; wants local environment with Rust 1.70 for a small systems test. Do we have Rust image?
Leah M.: We usually provide Python/Node images but we can provision a Rust VM. Dev infra: can we tag an image?
ops-bot: Provision request submitted: image "candidate-dev-rust-1.70". Reserved on node lab-2 for the PM slot. SSH details to be pasted in calendar note.
Sam (People Ops): Also candidate asked if we can provide a small white noise machine for the prayer/lactation room for privacy. Facilities - any issues?
Facilities Bot: White noise unit reserved and charged to visitor kit. Will be in Room H during reserved windows.
Rohan (Recruiter): Travel reimbursement: shes driving from Walnut Creek and will submit mileage + childcare receipts. Confirm mileage policy?
Sam (People Ops): Mileage: send odometer start/end + Google Maps route screenshot to expenses@redwood.com. For childcare, a receipt or invoice is required. We'll reimburse per standard policy and note the "one-off" caregiver reimbursement in case of evening pickup.
Leah M.: Security note: shes bringing a car seat and stroller; front desk asked for a short note on stroller parking location.
Facilities Bot: Curbside drop-off allowed at East Lobby; stroller parking in Delivery Room 1. Reception will assist. Badge to be printed with "visitor + stroller" note.
Rohan (Recruiter): I'll message candidate with the two-option schedule (split day vs single morning with lactation room) and childcare reimbursement details. Also will include instructions for expenses, parking, and SSH details once VM ready.
Sam (People Ops): Add-ons: mark calendar invites as "hybrid allowed" for PM panel, enable live captions for any remote attendees, and attach a short accessibility note.
Leah M.: Thanks all. If panels accept split day, please RSVP updates so I can finalize catering and Room H booking.
ops-bot: Calendar invites updated pending panel RSVPs; reminders scheduled 48h and 2h before each session.
Rohan (Recruiter): Sending candidate message now. Will loop back if she needs a hotel nightd; policy allows single-night for red-eye under $200.
Sam (People Ops): Closing loop — Ill prepare an expense template to include in the confirmation email (what to attach, subject line, reimbursement timeline). :white_check_mark:
